text.p: Michael Slater boosted his claim for a place in the fourth test with a quickfire 95 as Australia were denied victory over Scotland by the rain at Edinburgh today.
The Scots were struggling at 95 for six in reply to the visitors' 278 for nine when the rain forced the 50 overs match to be abandoned.

Slater, who shared an opening partnership of 143 in just 24 overs with Justin Langer (46), hit two sixes and twelve fours from just 80 balls and in one over helped himself to 20 off spinner Keith Sheridan.
But the left-arm Sheridan had considerable revenge, dismissing both Waugh twins Mark and Steve and finishing with figures of five for 65 in his 10 overs.
Any hopes the Scots had of chasing the target was quickly dispelled by paceman Michael Kasprowicz who snapped up three early wickets.
